task.title: Create High-Quality Out of Office Desk Sign PDF

user_message.content:
Create a printable Out of Office desk sign as a high-quality PDF (standard letter size 8.5x11 inches, portrait orientation). 

**Design requirements:**
- Style: Dramatic lighting, dark professional look (dark/black background with moody dramatic lighting effects, like spotlight or gradient lighting)
- Text should be in elegant white or gold/warm tones against the dark background
- Professional, high-end corporate aesthetic

**Content to include:**

1. A heading like "OUT OF OFFICE" at the top (prominent, stylish)

2. The person's headshot photo (use the file at /home/ubuntu/desk-sign/headshot.jpg) — display it prominently, perhaps with a circular crop or elegant frame, with dramatic lighting/vignette effect

3. The person's name: **Brandon Rose**

4. Job title: **Special Projects**

5. The following message text (use this exact wording):
"Although I am out of the office, I am always near my computer and have access to helping anyone in the office at all times... please do not hesitate to reach out if you or another one else in the company needs assistance... As always I am here to help in any way that I can"

6. Contact information:
   - Email: brandon@apartmentcorp.com
   - Phone: (323) 533-0117

**Technical requirements:**
- Output as a PDF file at /home/ubuntu/desk-sign/out_of_office_sign.pdf
- Make it look polished and professional — think high-end corporate or luxury branding aesthetic
- The headshot should be a key visual element
- Use Python with reportlab or similar library to generate the PDF
- Ensure the text is readable when printed (good contrast against dark background)
- The dramatic lighting can be achieved with gradients, vignettes, or spotlight effects on the dark background
